7. Termination for Breach. The Company may suspend or terminate your account immediately, without notice, if it determines in its sole discretion that you have violated these Terms.

8. Limitation of Liability. The Company's total liability arising out of or related to these Terms shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

9. Data Retention on Termination. Upon termination, Customer Data shall be retained for thirty (30) days to permit export, after which it will be permanently deleted.

10. Service Level. The Company targets 99.5% uptime, measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance windows announced at least twenty-four (24) hours in advance.
